target: Brandora workspace (Explore demo), desktop 1440 px, Chromium
tool: scripts/a11y-audit.js — Brandora’s own self-contained audit (WCAG 2.2 AA subset). No external script is loaded.
checks: Text contrast from computed styles (4.5:1; 3:1 for large text)
Accessible names for buttons, links and tabs

found: 20 texts below 4.5:1: muted navigation numbers and labels (2.44:1–4.35:1), demo-guide role labels (4.44:1), the “Lens” crew label (3.40:1), and status colours used as text on their own tint (red 4.19:1, orange 3.18:1, yellow 3.44:1, green 4.35:1, teal 4.32:1, grey 3.00:1)
A module number kept its grey on the highlighted (blue) navigation row (1.05:1)
Two heading-level skips (h2 → h4 on Home and Guideline insights cards; h1 → h3 on Company Hub source cards)

fixes: Status colours darkened so each is readable as text on its own tint: red #c0281d, orange #b54f0a, yellow #8a6500, green #13703a, teal #0c6c75, grey #6b665e
Muted text #6e6a64 → #5f5b55; navigation numbers inherit the row colour; demo-guide labels #5f5577; crew accent #8a5a00
Card titles use h3; Company Hub gains a screen-reader heading for its source list
The evidence panel’s reproduction of a low-contrast text (shown in the measured colours on purpose) is marked decorative; the same words and the measured ratio are given in readable text beside it
also_verified: “Skip to content” link to the main landmark
Visible 2 px focus outline on buttons, links and fields (:focus-visible)
No horizontal page overflow at 375 px on the document viewer
not_measurable_note: Text over images or gradients is reported as not measurable instead of guessed (7 elements across all screens, mainly creative previews).
limits: An automated audit cannot judge alt-text quality, reading order or screen-reader announcements; those need a manual pass with a screen reader. The public landing page is the approved design and was not changed.
